text:
Marisa: Quick note from the lease-swap sims: we observed lost-in-flight writes when ownership flipped mid-request. Proposal: proxy writes a tiny escrow record and becomes a delegate that replays to the eventual owner (durable delegate). Thoughts?

alex: Sounds like the least-surprising mitigation. Tradeoff = tail latency + small local storage. How do we prevent duplicates?

marisa: Each write gets a signed write_token + shard_seq. Replayer is at-least-once; target dedupes by token and validates seq windows.

devon: Residency is critical. EU-only tenants must never be forwarded outside region. Escrow must include residency_policy and proxy must enforce it; otherwise mark QUARANTINED and page ops.

sam: Durability concern: if proxy dies during outage we might lose escrow. Proposal: sync-replicate escrow to a local standby (replication=2) and ship metadata to control plane for visibility. TTLs short (default 180s).

nina: Observability asks: escrow_inflight, p95_forward_latency, quarantined_count, forward_retry_count. Include forward_attempt_id in traces.

alex: Client contract? I prefer non-blocking default.

marisa: Default returns 202 + X-Write-Token after local escrow commit. Background forwarder applies. Optional sync=true for callers that need immediate confirmation. Provide GET /escrow/{token} status endpoint.

devon: SLOs: default completion p95 <30s, page at 2m, quarantine after 5m. forward_retry_limit = 5.

marisa: Handshake: forwarder POST /handoff with signed token; target validates signature and owner. On mismatch reply 409 + owner_hint. Retries with exp backoff then escalate. Example snippet: POST /handoff {"write_token":"wt-ff12","shard":"s-42","seq_span":[12345,12347],"residency":"eu-only"}

ops-bot: [automation] set_defaults: escrow_replication=2; ttl_secs=180; forward_retry_limit=5; quarantine_retention_days=14.

sam: Operator UX: quarantined panel + manual forward (with two-person approval for sovereign tenants) + automated remediation job opt-in.

nina: Audit: every forward attempt logged (proxy-id, operator-id if manual, timestamps, result) and exported to long-term audit store.

marisa: Implementation estimate: 4w core + 2w integration. I'll draft a short RFC with token spec, escrow contract, metrics and rollout plan. Prototype in staging for non-sovereign tenants first. Tagging @alex @devon @sam @nina.
